name: Palm Eco-Town Development Co., Ltd
summary: Based in Guangzhou, China, Palm Eco-Town Development Co., Ltd. was established in 1984. This company is primarily engaged in the comprehensive design, planning, construction, and ongoing management of eco-towns across China. Additionally, its operations encompass landscaping projects, general engineering services, and the development of intelligent urban and rural infrastructure. The firm adopted its current name in April 2016, having previously operated as Palm Landscape Architecture Co., Ltd.
